headline: Logitech unveils new Pro-line gaming accessories including a haptic mouse
summary: Logitech introduced several new gaming accessories in its Pro line, including the G Pro Superstrike mouse, which uses haptic actuators instead of mechanical switches under its main buttons and costs $20 more than its predecessor, and a $60 mouse pad.
